Can you send:
- Per-1k-token baseline for US-hosted and EU-hosted endpoints (for text generation and chat workloads)
- How you calculate the residency adder (percentage vs fixed per-1k token) and any thresholds
- Typical discounts for committed monthly spend (1M / 5M / 20M tokens) and term lengths (6 vs 12 months)
- Any additional costs (eg. dedicated KV cache, long-term storage, audit logs) that commonly show up on European deployments

We need this to finalize the budget by EOD next Thursday. Can you get a formal quote over? Procurement is cc'd.

Hi Elena —

Thanks — summarized answers below and attached a draft rate card + residency worksheet for you and procurement. Short version first:

Baseline (hosted API, on-demand):
- US (N. Virginia): $0.80 per 1k prompt+generation tokens (combined avg for chat workloads)
- EU (Frankfurt): €0.95 per 1k prompt+generation tokens

Geo / Residency adders:
- Standard approach: a regional premium to cover additional infra, egress, and compliance (~ +15% over baseline) OR a fixed residency fee when customers require single-region isolation (we show that as €0.12 per 1k tokens in the worksheet).
- In practice: for EU-only processing we either apply the % premium (applied to the baseline regional price) or the fixed adder — worksheet shows both methods so you can see the math.

Committed discounts:
- 1M tokens/mo: 5% on baseline pricing with 6-month term
- 5M tokens/mo: 12% on baseline with 6-month term; 16% for 12-month term
- 20M tokens/mo+: custom pricing (we typically move to reserved / Dedicated pricing).

Common extras for EU deployments:
- Audit log retention beyond 90 days (optional) — priced per GB/month
- Customer-managed KMS (HSM) integration — one-time onboarding fee plus marginal per-region key usage
- Dedicated KV cache or higher memory profiles for latency-sensitive workloads — line-item in the worksheet

Next steps I suggest: I can convert the attached worksheet into a formal quote for procurement (DocuSign link) if you can confirm the expected monthly token profile (best guess is fine) and whether you require EU-only processing + customer KMS.

I’ve cc'd Karthik (pricing) to help with any nuance on the Residency adder approach.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Elena — quick note from the pricing team perspective:

We typically express the residency uplift two ways depending on customer preference:
1) Percent geo-premium applied to the regional baseline (common for short-term trials) — usually 12–18% for EMEA due to cross-region infra and compliance support.
2) Fixed sovereignity/data-residency adder (€/£ per 1k tokens) — common when customers want a predictable unit cost on forecasts.

For Finova (mid-market, finance sector) we can offer a compromise: 12% geo-premium or a fixed €0.10/1k residency adder. If Finova signs a 12-month commitment at >=5M tokens/mo we can reduce the adder to €0.06/1k or cap the geo-premium at 8%.

Alex — happy to prepare a couple of firm quote permutations (on-demand baseline + residency percent, on-demand baseline + fixed adder, and committed 12-mo pricing).

Soojin
Director, Strategic Pricing
Redwood Inference
